name: Eleanor Vance
bio:
Eleanor Vance's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aerodynamics and a childhood spent tinkering with model airplanes. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics. After graduating, she started her career at a smaller racing team, where she honed her skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics.

Over the years, Eleanor has developed a reputation for her sharp analytical mind and her ability to see the big picture. She believes in a holistic approach to performance engineering, considering not only the technical aspects but also the human factors that influence a driver's performance. Her innovative ideas and unwavering commitment to excellence have made her a valuable asset to Century Motorsport.

What sets Eleanor apart is her talent for spotting opportunities where others might only see problems. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to motivate her team to push the boundaries of what's possible. Eleanor's visionary approach to performance engineering makes her an invaluable leader.

physical.description: Eleanor is a woman of medium height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and equations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of Earl Grey tea before every race.
